title: OpenAI models and Codex now run on Oracle Universal Credits
meta_description: OpenAI says Oracle Cloud Infrastructure customers can now access its frontier models and Codex through existing Oracle Universal Credits, skipping separate procurement.
tldr: OpenAI announced on June 11 that Oracle Cloud Infrastructure customers can access its frontier models and Codex through their existing Oracle Universal Credits. The deal lets enterprises deploy OpenAI technology without opening a separate procurement channel, folding AI spend into a contract they already have.
body_markdown:
## The announcement

On June 11, 2026, OpenAI said enterprise customers can now access its frontier AI models and **Codex** through their existing **Oracle Universal Credits**. In practice, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) customers can deploy OpenAI technology without standing up a separate procurement channel or vendor agreement.

## Why procurement is the story

For large organizations, the blocker to adopting a new AI vendor is often not the model, it is the paperwork: security review, a new contract, and a new line item in the budget. Routing OpenAI access through Universal Credits, the pooled, prepaid spend OCI customers already manage, collapses that friction. Teams can draw down credits they have already committed to Oracle instead of negotiating a fresh deal.

## What it signals

The move fits a broader June 2026 pattern of AI labs meeting enterprises inside the clouds and toolchains they already run, rather than asking them to come to a standalone product. Bundling Codex into the same path is notable: it puts OpenAI's coding agent in front of enterprise developers who are already inside the Oracle ecosystem.

## What to watch

The open questions are how pricing maps onto Universal Credits, which specific frontier models are covered, and whether data residency and isolation guarantees on OCI match what regulated customers need before they move production workloads.

faq.question: What are Oracle Universal Credits?
faq.answer: They are Oracle's pooled, prepaid cloud spend model. Customers commit a credit balance and draw it down across OCI services. OpenAI access is now one of the things those credits can be spent on.

faq.question: Does this include Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. OpenAI's announcement covers both its frontier models and Codex, its coding agent, accessible to OCI customers through the same Universal Credits path.

faq.question: Do customers need a separate OpenAI contract?
faq.answer: According to the announcement, the point of the partnership is to avoid that: eligible OCI customers can deploy OpenAI technology without creating a separate procurement channel.
